name: Florian Hillen
headline: CEO of Videa | Making AI the standard of care in dentistry.
summary:
I am the Founder & CEO of VideaHealth, the leading dental AI platform. Our mission is to empower dental clinicians to provide better care, save time, and accelerate revenue through AI.

The Impact
For Dental Practices: Higher case acceptance, less administrative burden, and immediate revenue growth.
For Patients: Safer, transparent, and accurate treatments.

Background & Education My career operates at the intersection of AI, medicine, and business. I originally left my PhD program at Harvard to fully focus on building VideaHealth.

Previously, I conducted research at MIT and Harvard Business School, worked with McKinsey & Company, and founded a digital health startup.

MIT: M.S. in Computer Science (EECS) & M.S. in Technology Policy
Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität: Medicine (1st State Exam)
TU Munich: B.S. Management & Technology

I am also a Startup Mentor at the MIT Sandbox Innovation Fund and a frequent speaker on the future of healthcare AI.

company.name: Videa
company.tagline: We empower DSOs and dental practices to consistently deliver better patient care through AI.
company.description: Videa is transforming dentistry with AI-powered solutions that reduce complexity across the dental workflow and help practices elevate care standards, improve productivity, and drive real business value. Videa, a complete Dental AI platform, supports every aspect of dental care, from diagnostics and workflows to analytics and revenue optimization. Used by over 90,000 clinicians across more than 60 leading DSOs, Videa’s FDA-cleared AI analyzes over 500 million X-rays annually, delivering trusted insights that power consistent, high-quality care. Headquartered in Boston and backed by leading investors, Videa is advancing the future of dental care through responsible and real-world AI. Learn more at videa.ai.
